name: io.github.benjiprojects1404-maker/cadence
title: Cadence (Arc MCP)
description: Circle's Arc mainnet for AI agents: balances, quotes, rug alarms, payment links, OTC offers.

tools.name: arc_balances
tools.description: Balances of the ten Chord-listed tokens (USDC, EURC, GBPA, MXNB, WETH, cirBTC, LINK, VIRTUAL, ARGUS, ARCUS) for any Arc mainnet address. Read-only.

tools.name: arc_quote
tools.description: Real Uniswap v3 quote on Arc mainnet, including pool fee and slippage. side=buy: spend `amount` USDC on the token. side=sell: sell `amount` of the token for USDC. Tokens: EURC, WETH, cirBTC, ARGUS. Read-only; nothing is traded.

side.description: buy: spend USDC for the token; sell: sell the token for USDC

amount.description: Decimal amount: USDC when buying, token units when selling

tools.name: riptide_latest
tools.description: Latest Riptide check: the gap between Arc's Uniswap pools and Coinbase (or, for ARGUS, between Arc's v3 and v4 pools) at $10 and $1,000, after fees, and whether any pair is paused by the rug alarm. Riptide is a paper-trading monitor; it never trades.

tools.name: riptide_rug_alarms
tools.description: Rug-alarm events from Riptide: sudden price drops (20%+) or liquidity pulled (50%+) between two checks five minutes apart, on the Arc pools it watches.

tools.name: crescent_payment_link
tools.description: Make a Crescent payment link: whoever opens it can pay `amount` of `token` straight to `to` on Arc mainnet (no contract in between), and the page shows when the payment arrives. Only builds the link; nothing is signed or sent.

note.description: Optional note shown to the payer, e.g. an invoice number

tools.name: crescent_check_payment
tools.description: Check whether a payment of exactly `amount` `token` has reached `to` on Arc mainnet, optionally only counting transfers from `from_block` on (the `b` in a Crescent link). Uses the Arc explorer.

to.description: Recipient Arc address from the payment link

amount.description: Exact decimal amount the link asks for

from_block.description: Optional: only look at transfers from this Arc block on (the link's b= value)

tools.name: chord_offers
tools.description: Open offers on Chord OTC (peer-to-peer ERC-20 <-> USDC trades on Arc mainnet where funds never leave the maker's wallet until a fill). Newest first, with price, token (listed or not), private taker if any, expiry and whether each can be filled right now. Read-only.

limit.description: How many recent offers to scan (default 20)

token.description: Optional: only offers in this token (symbol of a listed token, or an address)

tools.name: chord_offer
tools.description: One Chord OTC offer by id: terms, status, whether it can be filled right now, and what a taker must approve first. Read-only.

tools.name: chord_prepare
tools.description: Prepare UNSIGNED Chord OTC transactions for the user to review and sign in their own wallet: create an offer, fill one, or cancel one. Returns the transactions in order (an approval first when needed) plus a plain-English summary. Nothing is signed or sent by this tool. Funds never sit in Chord: the maker's side stays in their wallet under an approval until a fill moves both sides in one transaction.

action.description: create a new offer, fill an open one, or cancel your own

wallet.description: The user's Arc address (used to check balance, approval and eligibility)

give.description: create: which side the user gives

token.description: create: the non-USDC token (listed symbol or address)

private_taker.description: create, optional: only this address may fill

expires_in_hours.description: create, optional: 0 or omitted = no expiry

tools.name: chord_token_check
tools.description: Safety check of any Arc token's code, the same check Chord's site runs on unlisted tokens: upgradeable proxy, owner powers (mint, pause, block wallets, change a tax, cap wallets, switch trading off) and a live transfer tax (which Chord refuses). Facts, not a rating. Read-only.

tools.name: pro_wallet_report
tools.description: PRO ($0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Arc via x402). Full report on any Arc address: every ERC-20 it holds (not just Chord's list) with the explorer's USD estimate and scam flags, whether it's a wallet or a contract (and which kind, e.g. a Safe), when it was created, its 20 latest token transfers in and out with counterparties, and any open Chord OTC offers it made. Read-only.

tools.name: pro_token_report
tools.description: PRO ($0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Arc via x402). Deep report on any Arc token: the code check from chord_token_check (upgradeable, owner powers, transfer tax), plus holders count, supply, 24h volume, the top 10 holders with their share of supply and who they are (burn address, Uniswap pool, contract, wallet), how concentrated it is outside burns and pools, and any Riptide rug alarms on it in the last 30 days. Facts, not a rating. Read-only.
